content.what_it_is: Large MATLAB analysis/figure script for the Zhang et al. 2022 idealized-beach case. It defines a shifted 960-by-480, 2 m grid and zero accumulators (L3-L46), changes to a result directory and binary-reads eta plus wave, mean-flow, radiation-stress, pressure-gradient, forcing, and momentum-flux fields for outputs 2 and 3 (L47-L177), averages every accumulated field and computes curl and x/y momentum residual sums (L179-L205). It returns to a paper directory, extracts prescribed transects (L205-L228), makes a four-panel eta/wave-height/setup/vorticity map (L230-L345), four alongshore momentum-budget profiles (L348-L408), and four cross-shore momentum-budget profiles (L410-L474), writing EPS/JPEG products.
entities: X,Y shifted 2-D grid and x,y vectors @L15-L25
yy1..yy3 and xx1..xx4 physical profile coordinates @L217-L224
unresolved: The statement `vbh=[0.0:1.0:3:0]` at L278 has four colon operands and is not a valid MATLAB colon expression; it executes even though `vbh` is unused, so it can stop the script before the remaining figures. The following contour uses a separate valid `[0:0.1:3]` at L279, consistent with a copied `3.0` typo.

Only Hsig/etamean/velocity/budget fields are accumulated and averaged over numb=2:3 (L59-L195). `eta` is overwritten on each iteration at L53-L57 and the map at L239 therefore shows only the last snapshot (numb=3) beside panels labeled from two-snapshot averages, an inconsistent temporal aggregation.

Every momentum-profile panel places its letter above the corresponding y-axis maximum: figure 3 uses 0.0014 vs ax1 max 0.0012 (L351,L374), 0.014 vs 0.012 (L352,L383), and 0.09 vs 0.075 for ax3/ax4 (L353-L354,L393,L403); figure 2 similarly uses 0.086>0.075, 0.15>0.135, 0.028>0.025, and 0.1>0.09 (L416-L419,L436,L445,L459,L469). With clipping, the subplot labels can be invisible.

All binary opens/reads assume success and exactly 960*480 singles (L54-L175); fileID and element counts are unchecked, and `cd` is changed via eval, so an early error can leave the caller in the results directory.
`tmp`, `icount`, `vbh`, and several txt_x/txt_y assignments are unused; plot output also assumes a pre-existing `plots` directory.
